description.text: Deep inside an unlit showroom, the black sports car sits nearly swallowed by shadow, its carbon-fibre body reduced to a faint contour against the polished floor and the dark glass behind it. The space feels sealed and quiet, with only a thin edge of emergency light grazing the car's roofline and the long reflections waiting on the ground. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening the darkness around the vehicle. Then the headlights snap on, throwing two narrow white beams across the empty floor. The car answers with a low engine rumble and begins to creep forward, its nose easing out of the blackness while the carbon-fibre panels catch a first sliding highlight. Dust motes drift through the beams, and the floor begins to mirror the shape of the car as it advances.
The showroom is almost black, with the car's outline barely separated from the surrounding darkness.
A faint electrical hum and close room tone fill the empty showroom.
The headlights ignite, casting twin beams across the polished floor.
A sharp relay click is followed by a low engine rumble.
The car creeps forward, its carbon-fibre panels catching a thin highlight.
Tyres whisper against the polished floor as the car begins to roll.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The car glides fully forward onto the lit showroom floor, its long black body emerging into a clean, cool wash of overhead light. The polished concrete beneath it doubles the vehicle in a soft, stretched reflection, while the darkness behind it closes like a curtain. The camera holds a static medium-wide shot as the car advances with slow, deliberate momentum and then eases to a halt, settling into the exact composition of the supplied final frame: the same showroom floor, the same backdrop, the same placement of the vehicle, and the same quiet live-action finish. Small highlights travel along the carbon-fibre shell and fade as the motion dies. The headlights remain on, two steady cones cutting into the empty space ahead, and the last of the engine's rumble softens into idle.
The car noses into the lit area, and its reflection opens across the floor beneath it.
The engine tone grows clearer as the car enters the open showroom.
The car glides forward in a smooth line, holding the frame as it approaches its final position.
Tyres roll evenly over the polished floor, accompanied by a low mechanical hum.
The car eases to a halt and settles into the final showroom composition.
The engine settles into idle, and the room tone returns around the vehicle.
The camera holds a static shot.
